title: Audit Event Envelope (v1)
description: Envelope for events emitted from inside n8n Code nodes via the kernel n8n-audit-emitter template (templates/n8n-audit-emitter.json). This is the payload the template POSTs to kernel.audit_emit. Required fields enforce REQ-KER-018 + RC-12 / F-12 (parent_id composition).

event_type.description: Audit event type (e.g., 'agent.dispatch', 'stream.event_handled', 'tool.call'). Defined by emitting node, recorded in governance audit.db event_type column.

trace_id.description: Causality root for this trace. Inherited from the incoming webhook event or computed at workflow start. All audit rows produced by this n8n execution share this trace_id.

parent_id.description: Identity of the emitting workflow node, formed as '<stream_id>:<n8n_node_id>' per F-12 per-node identity slot. The kernel relies on this composition so cross-system traces resolve node-level provenance.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC. Auto-set by the audit-emitter if absent on the inbound POST.

model_version.description: For agent.dispatch events: which Claude model the dispatched agent used.

system_prompt_hash.description: SHA-256 of the dispatched agent's system prompt; null for non-dispatch events.

prompt.description: Literal prompt content. Mutually exclusive with prompt_ref per RC-6 / F-04. KER-AE-004 audit_payload_mixed_forms if both are provided.

prompt_ref.description: Reference to prompt content stored elsewhere (RC-6).

response.description: Literal response content. See prompt for ref-form.

tool_calls.description: List of tool invocations during dispatch.

cot.description: Chain-of-thought if available; may be ref'd.

untrusted_regions.description: When dispatch_agent_v2 envelope form is used, the regions that contained untrusted input.

budget_echo.description: The budget object that governed this dispatch (echoed for traceability).

allOf.comment: RC-6 / F-04 mutual exclusion: prompt vs prompt_ref
RC-6 / F-04 mutual exclusion: response vs response_ref
